caption: The drawing features a single round object, centrally placed against a plain, off-white or lightly beige background. The object resembles a shallow bowl or plate viewed from above. It is primarily colored in shades of brown with darker, almost black, irregular spots or blotches distributed unevenly along its surface, with some concentrations forming loose circular patterns towards the center and the rim. The rim has a slightly darker outline enhancing its circular form, and gentle shading within the object creates a sense of curvature and depth. The drawing is simple, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Pie Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
